data.name: Aliona
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'eliyon', meaning 'my God is high'. The name Aliona is a feminine form of the Hebrew name Elion, which means 'God is my light'. This name was borne by a number of women in the Old Testament, including the wife of Eliab, the son of Jesse, and the wife of Ezra.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing faith, devotion, and divine guidance.
